error.title: This page could not be displayed
error.description: Something went wrong. Please try again, and contact the kindergarten office if it persists.

home.emptyChildren: No children linked to your account
home.emptyChildrenDescription: Contact the kindergarten office to link your child's file to this account.

checkin.title: Show this at the door
checkin.subtitle: Staff scan this code, then compare your photo with your child’s before confirming the arrival or the pick-up.
checkin.brightnessHint: If the scanner does not read the code, turn your screen brightness all the way up.
checkin.childrenHint: Pick the child you are dropping off or collecting. This is only a reminder for you — staff confirm attendance on the kindergarten’s own device.
checkin.sameCodeHint: The same code covers all your children. Picking one here is only a reminder for the doorway.
checkin.statusError: Today’s status could not be loaded.

noBadge.title: The office has not issued your badge yet
noBadge.description: The door badge is created once at the kindergarten office and tied to your name. Message the office to ask for it — it appears here as soon as it is issued.

noGuardian.title: Your account is not linked to a guardian record
noGuardian.description: A door badge cannot be issued before your account is linked to your record at the kindergarten. Message the office to finish the link.

applications.title: Enrolment requests
applications.description: Requests still with the office — they stay here until the kindergarten answers.
applications.processing: File received — being processed. The crèche will contact you.
applications.closed: File handled — contact the crèche about the next step.

review.title: Check the request
review.subtitle: One last look before it reaches the office.
review.note: The kindergarten reviews the request and gets back to you. Your own details come from your parent file — no need to type them again.

success.title: Request sent
success.message: {name} has received your request to enrol {child}. The team will review it and contact you soon.
success.hint: You can follow the request from “My children” until they answer.

errors.required: Please fill in the first name, last name, date of birth and gender.
errors.allergenRequired: Please name the allergen on every line you added, or remove the empty one.
errors.generic: The request could not be sent. Please try again in a moment.
errors.forbidden: Your account is not linked to this kindergarten. Please contact the office.
errors.noGuardianRecord: Your account has no parent file at this kindergarten yet, so the request cannot be sent. Please contact the office.

noGuardian.title: Your account is not linked to a parent file
noGuardian.description: To enrol another child, your account must be linked to a parent file at this kindergarten. Contact the office to have it linked.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: Your conversations with the kindergarten about your children.
messages.emptyDescription: Start a conversation with the kindergarten — a question, a request, anything about your child. Replies land right here.
messages.notFoundDescription: This conversation is not linked to your account, or it no longer exists.

dialog.title: New conversation
dialog.description: Ask the kindergarten a question. The office and your child's teacher are notified straight away.
dialog.subject: Subject
dialog.subjectPlaceholder: Request to change the pick-up time
dialog.messagePlaceholder: Write your message to the kindergarten…
dialog.created: Your conversation was sent to the kindergarten

absence.title: Report an absence
absence.description: Let the kindergarten know that {name} will be absent. The office is notified right away.
absence.success: Your report was sent to the kindergarten

child.notFoundDescription: This child is not linked to your account.

photo.title: Child's photo
photo.description: Staff compare it with your child's face at the door before handing them over — one clear, recent photo is all it takes.
photo.hint: Add a photo of your child — staff compare it at the door before handing them over.
photo.removeDescription: Without it staff have nothing to compare at the door, and pick-up may keep you waiting.
photo.saved: Your child's photo has been saved
photo.removed: Your child's photo has been removed
photo.tooLarge: That image is too large. Choose one under 20 MB.
photo.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this child's photo. Please contact the kindergarten office.
photo.error: The photo could not be saved. Please try again, and contact the kindergarten office if it keeps failing.

journal.title: Daily journal
journal.emptyDescription: Your child's daily journal appears here once the teacher publishes it.

health.parentEditNotice: You keep this information up to date yourself. Every change applies immediately and the kindergarten is notified right away.
health.allergyDialogDescription: As soon as you save, the team and the kitchen can see it.
health.deleteDescription: “{allergen}” will disappear from the file and the team will no longer see it. Only remove it if the allergy is gone.
health.savedNotified: Saved — the kindergarten has been notified
health.removedNotified: Removed — the kindergarten has been notified
health.recordEditDescription: This helps the team care for your child day to day.

placeholders.emergencyNotes: What the kindergarten should know in an emergency

health.identityNote: Name and date of birth come from the birth certificate — only the office can correct them.
health.allergyDuplicate: That allergen is already on the list

activities.enrolledEmpty: Not enrolled in any activity yet.
activities.availableEmpty: No other activity is available right now.
activities.requestDuplicate: A request already exists for this activity
activities.cancelTooLate: This request has already been approved. Contact the office to cancel it.

pickups.title: Authorized to collect your child
pickups.description: Besides you, these are the people allowed to collect {name} from the kindergarten. Each of them is asked for their ID card at the door.
pickups.legalNote: This list is the pickup-authorisation register required by executive decree 19-253, and it is kept in your child's official file.
pickups.officeNote: Every addition, change or removal reaches the office straight away and takes effect immediately.
pickups.empty: No one but you is authorized yet
pickups.emptyDescription: Add the grandmother, an uncle, the driver — anyone who might come for your child on a day you cannot come yourself.
pickups.dialogDescription: This person may collect your child on presentation of their ID card.
pickups.name: Full name
pickups.phoneInvalid: This phone number does not look right.
pickups.nationalIdHint: The ID number lets staff check who is at the door before handing your child over.
pickups.deleteDescription: {name} will no longer be allowed to collect your child, effective immediately. The office is notified of this change.
pickups.forbidden: This change could not be applied. Refresh the page or message the office.

consents.title: Consents
consents.description: Three questions the kindergarten needs your answer to. You can change any answer whenever you want.
consents.officeNote: Your answer is recorded under your name and dated, and the office sees it as soon as you choose.

typeHints.photos: Taking photos of your child and sharing them with you in the journal.
typeHints.outings: Your child taking part in organized outings away from the kindergarten.
typeHints.medical_emergency: Calling emergency services and getting your child treated if we cannot reach you.

consents.forbidden: Your answer could not be recorded. Refresh the page or message the office.

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Your children's invoices and payment history.
payments.emptyDescription: Kindergarten invoices appear here once they are issued.

cash.title: Pay in cash at the office
cash.body: Payments are made in cash at the kindergarten office, and you receive a numbered receipt on the spot. No online payment is needed.

fees.title: Your monthly fee
fees.description: What the crèche charges every month, before activities and extras.
fees.none: No fee on record. Ask the office.
fees.dueDay: Due on the {day}th of each month

payments.overdueHint: Overdue — please come by the office

announcements.title: News
announcements.description: Kindergarten announcements for parents and for your children's classes.
announcements.emptyDescription: Kindergarten announcements addressed to you appear here.

phones.title: Contact numbers
phones.lead: This is the number the kindergarten calls first if your child falls ill or has an accident — a wrong number here costs the minutes that matter most.
phones.phoneAltHint: Called when the main number does not answer — a spouse, a grandparent, your workplace.

details.title: My details
details.description: What the kindergarten office holds about you as a parent.
details.relationshipReadOnly: Set by the kindergarten office — it cannot be changed here.
details.appliesToAll: You have {count} children's files at this kindergarten — a change is saved to all of them at once.
details.saved: Your details were updated. The office sees the change straight away.
details.noFileDescription: Your account is not linked to a parent file at this kindergarten yet. Contact the office and they will link it.

photo.title: My photo
photo.description: Staff check this at the door before handing over your child — a clear photo of your face is all it takes.
photo.removeDescription: Without it staff cannot recognise you quickly at the door, and you may be kept waiting.
photo.tooLarge: That image is too large. Choose one under 20 MB.
photo.forbidden: The photo could not be uploaded. Please contact the kindergarten office.
photo.error: The photo could not be saved. Please try again.

account.title: Account and language
account.description: How you sign in, and the language the portal speaks to you in.
account.fullNameHint: Shown at the top of the portal and next to your messages.
account.phoneHint: Attached to your login. It is not the number called in an emergency — that one is above.
account.emailHint: Contact the office to change the address you sign in with.
account.languageHint: Applies to the portal and to the alerts sent to your phone.

children.title: My children
children.readOnly: Names and dates of birth come from the birth certificate and feed the official registers — only the office can correct them.
children.empty: No children linked to your account yet.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Get a notification on this phone when the kindergarten posts something about your child.
alerts.denied: Notifications are off for Rawdati. Turn them on in Settings to be alerted.

signOut.hint: You will need your email and password to sign back in.

errors.load: Your details could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this. Contact the kindergarten office.
